scope: Retained stdin, environment and file service acceptance through Oop messages and collecting declared callbacks
retained_checks: Binary stdin, empty lines, CR preservation, 20000-byte line, final unterminated line, EOF and input error.
Missing, empty, UTF-8 and invalid environment names/values; exact String recognition and late Error factory publication.
All 256 byte values in file roundtrips, truncation, malformed filenames, argument refusal without side effects, and source calls.
Contents callback mutates the earlier filename byte provider under GC; the original filename snapshot determines the write.
Exact native failure identity, no write on contents failure, live collecting factories and replacements preserved by module reload.
